h1: Support email reply drafts your team can approve fast
overview: Your team writes the same answers many times a day. We set up drafting so that each new support email arrives with a suggested reply already written in your tone, using your policies and past answers. A person reads it, edits if needed and sends. Nothing leaves your inbox automatically, which keeps quality in your hands while cutting the typing and the time spent searching for the right wording.

faq: Does it send replies by itself?
No. Drafts are saved for a person to review and send. This keeps control with your team and avoids a wrong answer reaching a customer.
Does it work with Gmail, Outlook or Zendesk?
Yes, all three, along with Help Scout, Freshdesk and Gorgias. Tell us what you use and we confirm the method before we start.
How will drafts match my voice?
You share past replies you are proud of. We turn them into examples and a short tone guide, then check the first drafts with you and adjust.
What if the customer is angry or the case is sensitive?
We add rules that skip drafting for complaints, legal threats, refunds above a set value and similar cases, and flag them for a senior person instead.
